budget_vs_user.notes_base: Fixed costs (meals + matcha cafe) total 270 CNY (13.5% of budget). Remaining 1,730 CNY (86.5%) is flexible shopping budget. Meals increased by 72 CNY vs previous plan due to updated restaurant selections.

warnings: Meals cost increased by 72 CNY: lunch updated from Green Tea Restaurant (60 CNY) to THE WOODS (131 CNY). This reduces shopping budget from 1,793 CNY to 1,730 CNY.
Entertainment updated: % Arabica Coffee replaced by Jiushiye Matcha (46 CNY). Alternatively théATRE Tea Space (75 CNY) available in same mall at 29 CNY higher cost.
Optional Slow Boat Brewery (100 CNY evening) not included in base budget. If visited, shopping budget reduces to 1,630 CNY.
Shopping budget of 1,730 CNY is generous for mid-range stores but tight for luxury. Jinbao Place (1,000+ CNY per item) should be visited only if other shopping is limited.

optimization_recommendations.details_base: THE WOODS (131 CNY) is the highest single meal cost. Cheaper alternatives near Wangfujing: Green Tea Restaurant at in88 3F (~60 CNY, saves 71 CNY) or a food court meal (~40-50 CNY, saves 81-91 CNY). Shopping budget increases to 1,801-1,821 CNY.

optimization_recommendations.action_base: Choose Jiushiye Matcha (46 CNY) over théATRE Tea Space (75 CNY)
optimization_recommendations.details_base: Both are in Wangfu Zhonghuan. Jiushiye Matcha is 29 CNY cheaper and rated 4.5 stars. théATRE is more photogenic but costs more. Sticking with Jiushiye saves 29 CNY for shopping.

optimization_recommendations.action_base: Skip Slow Boat Brewery to preserve full shopping budget
optimization_recommendations.details_base: Slow Boat Brewery is an optional 100 CNY evening activity. Skipping keeps shopping budget at 1,730 CNY vs 1,630 CNY. Evening stroll on Wangfujing Pedestrian Street (free) is equally enjoyable.

optimization_recommendations.action_base: Prioritize Beijing APM and Wangfujing Department Store over Wangfu Central and Jinbao Place
optimization_recommendations.details_base: Both Wangfu Central (500+ CNY items) and Jinbao Place (1,000+ CNY per item) are optional luxury stops. Focus budget on APM and Department Store for better value within 2,000 CNY total.

optimization_recommendations.action_base: Visit B1 Elite Supermarket at Wangfujing Department Store for food souvenirs
optimization_recommendations.details_base: The basement supermarket stocks Beijing specialties (Daoxiangcun pastries, teas, baijiu miniatures) at reasonable prices. Budget 50-100 CNY here for souvenirs instead of gift shops.
All attractions are within 1km walking distance. Subway (3 CNY) is unnecessary. Keep all transportation savings for shopping.

trip_summary.notes_base: 1-day shopping trip to Wangfujing + Dongdan. Fixed costs (meals + matcha cafe) are 270 CNY (13.5%), leaving 1,730 CNY (86.5%) for shopping. Meals increased by 72 CNY vs previous plan due to updated restaurant selections (THE WOODS lunch + Hen Jiu Yi Qian dinner). Budget remains on target at 2,000 CNY total.
